title: Idea
description: An idea on the Agora queue, as Agora serves it. Owned by Agora. The tier comes from the Charter's Scope rules applied to jurisdiction_id and topic_ids, never from the proposer.

jurisdiction_id.description: The idea's current jurisdiction: the one it was filed under, or the narrower one a ScopeChallenge decided. The queue filters on it.

filed_jurisdiction_id.description: The jurisdiction the proposer filed the idea under. Pseudonyms for the idea (proposer, upvotes, challengers, panel votes) are made for this area. Agora always sends it; optional so readers of older answers still validate.

proposer_nym.description: The proposer's pseudonym inside Agora, never a person.

scope_tier.description: The current tier: Scope applied to jurisdiction_id. A contested idea keeps its tier until its challenge is decided.

charter_version.description: The Charter version the current tier was computed under.

upvote_count.description: Upvotes so far; null while the count is hidden (Charter agora.upvote_hidden_hours after created_at).

contested.description: True while a ScopeChallenge against the idea's tier is open. Agora always sends it; optional so readers of older answers still validate.
